title: BPW-2026-0515
text:
[BUREAU OF STREET SERVICES]
BPW-2026-0515
CD 8
TREE REMOVAL – CITYWIDE SIDEWALK REPAIR PROGRAM IN COUNCIL DISTRICT EIGHT
Recommending the Board:
DETERMINE that the sidewalk repair project at 2912 South Hobart Boulevard,2923 South Hobart Boulevard, 3007 South La Salle Avenue, 2658 South Harvard Boulevard, 3000 South Dalton Avenue and 1620 West 30th Street, is within the scope of the Sidewalk Repair Program (SRP) as described in the SRP Environmental Impact Report (EIR) under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), approved in 2021 and 2026, and that the 2021 and 2026 SRP EIR adequately describe the Project for purposes of CEQA;
APPROVE the Project as a Non-Qualifying Sidewalk Repair Program Project pursuant to LAMC 62.104.1(b)(3), including
CONCUR with the Bureau of Engineering’s (BOE’s) approval of the project;
APPROVE the removal of two Jacaranda trees, three Camphor trees tree and one Chinese Elm tree for the reconstruction of an inaccessible sidewalk and tree replacements; and
DIRECT the BOE that a notice of determination be filed with the State Office of Planning and Research and the Los Angeles County Clerk.
summary: Approval of sidewalk repair project including tree removal at six addresses in Council District 8.
